subject: COLLATING SEQUENCE clause
notes: Data-name-1 shall be a name specified as the data-name in an ALTERNATE RECORD KEY or RECORD KEY clause of the file control entry. ResolveFileCollating builds the declared key-name set from FileModel.RecordKeyName plus AlternateKeyNames and rejects any Format-2 name outside it with COBOL1582. SR5 (the record-key-name spelling) is NOT claimed by this row: the test names a data-name.
